descriptionChirho: Adjective meaning 'middle' or 'central,' used to describe the middle story of a building (especially in temple/palace architecture) or the middle position in a series. All translations converge: Spanish 'del medio' (of the middle), Arabic 'الوُسْطَى' (the middle/central), Hindi 'बीच वाली / बीच का / मध्यम' (middle one / of middle / medium), Korean '가운데의' (of the middle), Swahili 'cha kati / vya kati' (of the center). The two clusters differ only in preposition—bare 'the middle' versus 'from the middle'—both describing the same spatial-positional concept.
